widget.title: Failed runs — chosen COB (latest if none)

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql: SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(MAX(timestamp), MINUTE) AS ts, COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED') AS failed FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) = @Source) AND JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) = IF(@COB = '*', (SELECT MAX(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date)) FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)), @COB)

SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(MAX(timestamp), MINUTE) AS ts, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED', JSON_VALUE(json_payload.unit), NULL)) AS books_hit FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) = @Source) AND JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) = IF(@COB = '*', (SELECT MAX(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date)) FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)), @COB)

WITH r AS (SELECT timestamp, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) AS cob, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.unit) AS book, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) AS status, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) AS source, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.error) AS error FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) = @Source)), picked AS (SELECT IF(@COB = '*', MAX(cob), @COB) AS cob FROM r), latest AS (SELECT book, ARRAY_AGG(status ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS status, MAX(timestamp) AS ts, COUNT(*) AS runs, ARRAY_AGG(IF(error = '', NULL, error) IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS last_error FROM r WHERE cob = (SELECT cob FROM picked) GROUP BY book), previous AS (SELECT DISTINCT book FROM r WHERE cob = (SELECT MAX(cob) FROM r WHERE cob < (SELECT cob FROM picked))), not_started AS (SELECT book FROM previous WHERE book NOT IN (SELECT book FROM latest)) SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(MAX(ts), MINUTE) AS ts, COUNTIF(status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'COMPLETED')) AS processed FROM latest

widget.title: Books still to process (not done + not started)

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT timestamp, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) AS cob, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.unit) AS book, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) AS status, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) AS source, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.error) AS error FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) = @Source)), picked AS (SELECT IF(@COB = '*', MAX(cob), @COB) AS cob FROM r), latest AS (SELECT book, ARRAY_AGG(status ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS status, MAX(timestamp) AS ts, COUNT(*) AS runs, ARRAY_AGG(IF(error = '', NULL, error) IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS last_error FROM r WHERE cob = (SELECT cob FROM picked) GROUP BY book), previous AS (SELECT DISTINCT book FROM r WHERE cob = (SELECT MAX(cob) FROM r WHERE cob < (SELECT cob FROM picked))), not_started AS (SELECT book FROM previous WHERE book NOT IN (SELECT book FROM latest)) SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), MINUTE) AS ts, (SELECT COUNTIF(status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'COMPLETED')) FROM latest) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM not_started) AS pending

SELECT JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) AS source, COUNT(*) AS failed FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED' AND IF(@COB = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) = @COB) GROUP BY source ORDER BY failed DESC

widget.title: Books — latest status on the chosen COB (to-do first)

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT timestamp, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) AS cob, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.unit) AS book, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) AS status, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) AS source, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.error) AS error FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) = @Source)), picked AS (SELECT IF(@COB = '*', MAX(cob), @COB) AS cob FROM r), latest AS (SELECT book, ARRAY_AGG(status ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS status, MAX(timestamp) AS ts, COUNT(*) AS runs, ARRAY_AGG(IF(error = '', NULL, error) IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS last_error FROM r WHERE cob = (SELECT cob FROM picked) GROUP BY book), previous AS (SELECT DISTINCT book FROM r WHERE cob = (SELECT MAX(cob) FROM r WHERE cob < (SELECT cob FROM picked))), not_started AS (SELECT book FROM previous WHERE book NOT IN (SELECT book FROM latest)) SELECT book, status, runs, ts AS last_update, last_error FROM latest UNION ALL SELECT book, 'NOT STARTED', 0, NULL, NULL FROM not_started ORDER BY IF(status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'COMPLETED'), 1, 0), book LIMIT 500

widget.title: Failed runs per hour, by source

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql: SELECT timestamp, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) AS source FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED' AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) = @Source) AND IF(@COB = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) = @COB) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100000

widget.title: Where it failed and how widely (COB × source × system)

opsAnalyticsQuery.sql: SELECT JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) AS cob, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) AS source, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.system) AS system, COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED') AS failed, COUNTIF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'RUNNING') AS running, COUNT(*) AS runs, COUNT(DISTINCT IF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED', JSON_VALUE(json_payload.unit), NULL)) AS books_hit, ANY_VALUE(IF(JSON_VALUE(json_payload.status) = 'FAILED', JSON_VALUE(json_payload.error), NULL)) AS example_error FROM `__PROJECT__.global._Default._AllLogs` WHERE log_name = 'projects/__PROJECT__/logs/control-table' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND IF(@Source = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.source) = @Source) AND IF(@COB = '*', TRUE, JSON_VALUE(json_payload.date) = @COB) GROUP BY cob, source, system HAVING failed > 0 ORDER BY cob DESC, failed DESC LIMIT 200
